name: Nonda Mako
source:
The protagonist's sister in law. She is the younger sister of Miya and a student. When she is not at school, she helps out at an inn. 

She is a clumsy girl and is easily distracted. She has a habit of masturbating, but is still a virgin. However, she is at an impressionable age and is surprisingly aggressive.

[From [url=https://www.ammolite-game.com/amml_006/chara_2.html]official site[/url]]
